base: outbound provider requests work in workerd and reject redirects without forwarding credentials
signatures bind exact method, endpoint, query, body and timestamp before any upstream access
concurrent replay consumes one request and stores only expiring hashes
session creation rejects foreign accounts and forces safe configuration while removing MCP credentials
every session operation checks ownership before reading, changing or executing it
accounts and direct execution cannot cross owners and account metadata strips nested credentials
verified uploads use private random objects and execute through a fresh owned account session
provider errors and unexpected key-containing responses are bounded and do not leak secrets
holdout: session execution requires an owned pinned account and denies hidden meta-tool execution
raw proxy supports bounded Gmail reads and rejects arbitrary paths, headers, methods and custom auth
session search and tool schemas cannot widen the public catalog or enabled toolkit filter
unexposed endpoints cannot bypass ownership or initiate unverified OAuth
managed uploads fail closed and tool arguments cannot reference shared project files
file capabilities enforce owner, exact action/account, metadata, expiry and owned cleanup
uploads reject foreign or unavailable accounts and malformed bytes before storage mutations
storage redirects, unexpected hosts, helper mismatches and broadened hidden sessions fail closed with cleanup
inherited object names cannot authorize custom toolkits or select authentication configurations
